description: A radar chart with a visible 0 to 100 value scale along one spoke.
overview: A `RadarChart` that adds a `PolarRadiusAxis` with five ticks over a fixed 0 to 100 domain, plus one filled `Radar` series. `chartData` has one record per axis (`skill`) with `thisMonth` and `lastMonth` scores. Pressing the chart shows a tooltip.
usage: Replace `chartData` with your records and set the `PolarRadiusAxis` `domain` to your value range. Rename the series in `chartConfig`. The component takes no props.
